Guys, one of the most underrated career skills...  
Is knowing how to communicate clearly.

You can have great technical skills, but if you cannot explain your ideas, your value may not be understood.

**👉 1. Think before you speak**  
Don't rush to answer. Take a moment, organize your thoughts, and then respond clearly 🧠
